Create one original Summonlab candidate summon portrait as a cinematic semi-realistic painted drawing. Use visible brush planes and controlled illustrative detail: not a photograph, not photoreal skin, not plastic 3D, and not cel anime. Portrait canvas 1024 x 1536. Exactly one weaponless adult, full body, three-quarter standing pose, with the entire head, both hands, both feet, hair, clothing, and all accessories fully inside a generous safe margin. Warm pale parchment studio wash, restrained warm color response, soft grounding shadow, no environmental story.

New identity Kaan Esho: 31-year-old man, 148 cm (very-short), conditioned athletic construction with functional tone but no ripped definition, skin value band-4-medium. Face: round full face; high cheekbones and softly lidded eyes; long straight nose, narrow upper lip; one cheek mole. Calm closed-mouth neutral expression with no smile, grin, or theatrical acting.

Hair: blonde-gold, curls-coils-halo, deliberate accent: none. Wardrobe: short-jacket-trousers, specifically a shaped short jacket, practical closures, generous trousers, and low boots; a divided hem and broad folded collar; bounded palette lilac-smoke. Visible personal details: a dense freckle field; a patterned collar insert; a tiny nose stud. Make body construction and habitual posture the primary recognition device. Maintenance cue: meticulous daily maintenance. Color treatment: balances one confident color field against quiet neutrals. Pose cue: posture is upright but not military, with wrists loose and hands readable. Include a folded handkerchief only as a quiet personal object, never as a weapon.

This is ordinary but intentionally designed 1-star mortal clothing. No weapon, armor, crown, magic, aura, or glow.
